q: How much does an extension or loft conversion cost?
a: Most extensions we build come in between £55,000 and £120,000, and loft conversions between £45,000 and £75,000, depending on size and specification. You'll get a detailed, itemised quotation before any work starts — never a vague day rate.

q: Is the price you quote really the price I pay?
a: Yes. Every quotation is itemised line by line before work starts, so you can see exactly where your money goes. Unless you change the scope of the project mid-build, the price we quote is the price you pay.

q: How long will my build take?
a: A typical loft conversion takes 8–12 weeks on site and an extension 10–16 weeks. We agree the schedule with you before we start, and keeping to it is part of the deal — not a nice-to-have.

Often not — many loft conversions and single-storey extensions fall under permitted development rights. Jason will tell you where you stand at the first site visit, and we'll point you to the right people for drawings and applications where they're needed.

q: Who will actually run my project?
a: Jason Berry, personally. He's the person who visits your home, prepares your quotation, manages the build day to day and hands the finished project over. One director, one point of contact, one person answerable throughout.
We're based in Sawbridgeworth (CM21) and build across London, Kent and Essex. If you're just outside those areas, give Jason a call — it's usually worth a conversation.
